traits.note: Jepson's Manual of the Flowering Plants of California (1925), read in full, Fumariaceae: stamens 6, in 2 sets of 3 opposite the outer petals, the filaments of each set usually united; capsule 1-celled with 2 parietal placentae; corolla 2-spurred or 2-saccate at base, the petals of Dicentra formosa united to above the middle.

traits.petal_whorls.note: Flora of North America vol. 3, Fumariaceae (read 2026-10-19): petals 4, in 2 dissimilar pairs, the outer pair swollen or spurred at the base, the inner pair narrower, clawed and crested; drawn as two whorls of two.
